_source: ADR Chapter 3.3 — special provisions. PART 6 (final) — numbers 675–678.

provisions.675: Concerns over-moulded cylinders (continuation of special provision 674) — procedure where acceptance criteria are not met: the owner must isolate the defective subgroup (no further filling or making available), carry out additional testing in agreement with the competent authority, and, as appropriate, extend the measures to the entire basic manufacturing series or limit them to the defective part of the subgroup; requirements for filling points (compliance with P200(7), electronic identification, access to the database, an ISO 9000 or equivalent quality management system).
provisions.676: These goods must not be loaded together with Class 1 substances or articles (other than division 1.4S). Separately: for the carriage of polymerizing substances for disposal or recycling, the requirements of special provision 386 and of 7.1.7.3/.4, 5.4.1.1.15, and 5.4.1.2.3.1 need not be applied provided: no significant temperature difference is found on pre-loading inspection, carriage takes place within 24 hours of that inspection, protection from sun/heat is provided, ambient temperature is <45°C, ventilation is adequate, and packages are ≤1000 l (additional inhibitors may be added).
provisions.677: Cells or batteries that are damaged or defective (per special provision 376), and which under normal conditions of carriage may rapidly disassemble, react dangerously, produce a flame, or emit a dangerous evolution of heat or a dangerous emission of toxic, corrosive or flammable gases — transport category 0; the transport document must be supplemented with "Transport category 0".
provisions.678: Waste contaminated with free (unbound) asbestos (UN Nos. 2212/2590) may be carried under Chapter 7.3 provided: it is carried only from the place of generation to the place of final disposal (intermediate storage without unloading or transferring the bag is permitted), the waste falls into specified categories (road waste, contaminated soil, construction articles/materials/waste contaminated with asbestos, including items too large for standard packing), it is not mixed with other asbestos waste or with other dangerous or non-dangerous waste, each consignment constitutes a full load (1.2.1), and the transport document complies with 5.4.1.1.4.
